# Tenaciti

> Tenaciti is an AI-powered study workspace for university students. It extracts a
> semester roadmap (deadlines, grade weights, assessments) from a PDF syllabus,
> tracks topic-level confidence ratings, links notes in a Markdown knowledge graph
> with wikilinks, and includes a free GPA calculator built on Pakistan's HEC 4.0
> grading scale (with support for custom scales). The AI Assistant is a conversational,
> action-taking agent for the whole workspace — it can answer questions about your
> courses, recommend what to study next, create notes, update goals, complete topics,
> link content, and build study plans, all from natural-language prompts.

## Key facts
- Free plan: 3 document uploads per course/month, 10 MB max file size, no credit card required.
- Premium plan: 20 uploads per course/month, 25 MB max, adds slide/notes extraction.
- Syllabus roadmap extraction supports PDF only. Slide/notes extraction supports PDF and PPTX.
- The GPA calculator defaults to the HEC 4.0 scale and supports fully custom grade scales.
- The GPA calculator is free to use with no account required, at /tools/gpa-calculator.
- The AI Assistant understands the user's courses, topics, notes, goals, and deadlines,
  answers questions about them, recommends what to study next, searches the workspace,
  and takes actions such as creating notes, updating goals, completing topics, linking related
  content, and building study plans — all from natural-language prompts.

## Guides & Blog
- The HEC 4.0 GPA Scale, Explained: https://www.tenaciti.app/blog/hec-4-0-gpa-scale-explained — HEC recommends a 4.0-point scale but doesn't mandate one universal table; every university sets its own bands.
- How to Turn a Syllabus Into a Study Plan: https://www.tenaciti.app/blog/syllabus-to-study-plan — Step-by-step method to extract deadlines and grade weights from a PDF syllabus and build a semester plan.
- Confidence Calibration and Exam Performance: https://www.tenaciti.app/blog/confidence-calibration-exam-performance — Why feeling confident and being prepared are different things, and what the research says about closing the gap.
- Note Linking and the Zettelkasten Method for Students: https://www.tenaciti.app/blog/note-linking-zettelkasten-students — Why linking notes beats organizing them, adapted from Luhmann's Zettelkasten for a university semester.
- How Tenaciti's AI Assistant Works: https://www.tenaciti.app/blog/how-tenaciti-ai-assistant-works — A conversational interface that can answer questions about your workspace and take direct actions.
- Lecture Slides to Study Checklist: https://www.tenaciti.app/blog/lecture-slides-to-study-checklist — How to turn lecture slides into a checklist that tracks understanding, not just completion.
